d: Long, straight ash-brown hair with blunt bangs and a side-swept fringe is adorned with a blue ribbon and orange floral ornament. Olive-green eyes are almond-shaped with a gentle expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a white apron-style dress over a green and white kimono with ruffled shoulders, featuring a brown utility belt and a large brown tool pouch labeled "LG-11". Signature details include a dark blue arm band with a white logo and green plant leaves protruding from the apron's pockets.
